gotchas: Sign-in at app.todoist.com/auth/login takes email and password on one page; 'Log in' submits. No code or captcha on 2026-10-09.

A first sign-in lands on onboarding (Welcome button, a name box + Next, a how-will-you-use-it radio, then more Next steps). The onboarding's later Next button stops advancing; skip it by opening /app/settings/subscription directly, which loads the app with the subscription dialog.

In the subscription dialog, the 'Pro' button shows the plan, then 'Get' (Get Pro) opens a hosted Stripe Checkout page: plain card inputs on the page (autocomplete cc-number, cc-exp, cc-csc, cc-name) and a country select, below an Apple/Google Pay express frame. The submit reads 'Start trial'.

Verified 2026-10-09 through the staging proxy with the public test card under a verification-only key: number, expiry and CVC filled (card_fields_verified), no aria-invalid. Stopped before Start trial.
